description: BinSkim - Microsoft's binary static analysis tool checking PE/ELF binaries for security hardening
notes: Packaged from the official NuGet package (a nupkg is a zip) - only the self-contained win-x64 payload is extracted, so no .NET runtime is needed.
Since 4.4.9.14, the payload is under tools\win-x64 without a target framework in the path.
checkver watches the NuGet version index rather than GitHub releases: the nupkg is what gets downloaded, and a version listed there is guaranteed to have it.
